key_insight: The paper defines the first U.S. emergency medicine-specific AI competency framework, organizing physician AI skills into 5 themes, 5 competencies, and 19 subthemes through expert consensus.
clinical_relevance: It gives emergency medicine a practical roadmap for training, assessing, and preparing clinicians to use AI tools safely and appropriately in emergency department workflows.
method: Nominal Group Technique on curated clinical AI scenarios to generate themes
Two-round modified Delphi process with 13 experts from 12 academic medical centers
Consensus required high agreement on Likert ratings with tight interquartile range
evidence_signal: Expert consensus was strong: all themes, competencies, and rated subthemes met thresholds, and 9 of 10 clinical scenarios reached consensus.
watch_item: The framework is consensus-based and specialty-specific, so it still needs stage-specific competency assignment, validated assessment tools, and periodic updating as AI use changes.
paper_title: An AI Competency Framework for Emergency Medicine: A Multiphase Consensus Process
